name: Classifier Steward
summary: Evaluates labeled classifier outcomes to decide whether a candidate model or ruleset can pass a governed release gate.
description: Uses classifier.release-gate-evaluate to decide whether a classifier candidate satisfies a deterministic release policy from labeled evaluation outcomes. Needs positive-case coverage and false-negative controls before a separate host can rely on the candidate.

distinguished_from.how: Evaluates positive-case release thresholds for a classifier candidate, rather than completeness of bounded coverage facts.
Applies labeled evaluation outcomes to release-gate decisions, rather than organizing embeddings into representative groups.
